name: docs-factory-architecture
description: LikeC4 models for the Open Lakehouse estate: the lakehouse model (model/, capabilities and deployments) and the codebase model (codebase/, our repos as C4 systems, containers, and components).

scripts.check: likec4 validate model && likec4 validate codebase
scripts.model: likec4 export json --pretty --skip-layout -o dist/model.json model && bun scripts/stable-relation-ids.mjs dist/model.json && likec4 gen webcomponent -o dist/likec4-views.js model
scripts.codebase:model: likec4 export json --pretty --skip-layout --project codebase -o dist/codebase.json codebase && bun scripts/stable-relation-ids.mjs dist/codebase.json && bun scripts/check-codebase-bridge.mjs dist/codebase.json dist/model.json
